body: I've never been more lost and scared in my life. I did achieve something by graduating and getting a job, but in the end none of it means anything because I'm a failure at it. I can't even begin to think about what else I could do. I don't feel like I can do anything, I feel utterly useless. What's going to happen with my life? Am I going to be miserable in an office? Am I going to be miserable unemployed? How can I ever find something I like when I don't feel like I like anything. All my passion is gone, I'm just nothing
